sources: 2016 courtyard, 2017 courtyard and two geolocated February 2021 Beijing West Road views cited in reference-review.json
observations: The deep arched western portico is separate from the southern fanlight and the gallery on the street return.
The plaque sill above the entrance clears the arch crown. The opening is open along the three upper rays as well as at the landing.
The south wall includes upper paired arches, a small cantilevered balcony and three bays of upper rectangular windows.
scope: Eastern and rear fragments remain as ordinary source buildings. Heights and the incomplete near roof are estimated.
